notes.notes: [p][b]Horror Tales Eats The World[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670730/Horror_Tales_Eats_The_World/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Through a photorealistic bodycam perspective, you will find hidden tapes in abandoned and cursed locations, each revealing a unique and paranormal horror story. Stay silent, because the slightest sound can lead you to deadly dangers...[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="7KfSb1MpiyY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]About the HORROR TALES EATS THE WORLD[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173193/5f71a37b7230eadeae5d2e8439b9195aee88940d.jpg"][/img][b]Multiple Found Footage Scenarios:[/b] Each tape tells a different horror story that fits the atmosphere of the environment you discover. From the darkness of the forest to the void of space; from the dark chambers of the Giza Pyramids to the mysterious ruins of Cambodian temples, every new discovery drags you into a completely different nightmare.[/p][p][b]Microphone Sensitivity:[/b] Our game operates based on your microphone. If you raise your voice too much, your character dies instantly! So stay calm, hold your breath, and survive.[/p][p][b]Location-Based Horror Stories:[/b] Each environment has its own unique terrors and chilling atmosphere, offering a realistic experience.[/p][p][b]Found Footage Gameplay:[/b] Experience horror through bodycam, mobile phone, and VHS camera angles. The terrifying sounds and visual atmosphere of each location will keep you constantly on edge.[/p][p][b]Hyper-Realistic Environments:[/b] A world awaits you that pushes the boundaries of fear with the most realistic graphics and sound design.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Loud Sounds Fix & Minor Improvements
notes.notes:
🛠️ What’s New?

Fixed an issue where some sounds were playing too loudly.

Minor balance adjustments and performance improvements.

Small optimizations to improve overall experience.

💡 Note:
If you notice any new audio issues, please let me know!

notes.title: Black Light Kills - Update v1.1.0 Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed Note Reading Stutter[/b]
You will no longer experience stuttering or freezing when reading notes in the game.

[b] Environmental Bug Fixes[/b]
Various visual and environmental issues across the map have been fixed. Stuttering problems have been resolved.

 [b]Missing Subtitles Added[/b]
Missing subtitles in some scenes have been added, allowing you to follow the dialogues more completely.
